name: compressor_inlet_drop_speed_leakage
title: Compressor with inlet pressure drop and speed-dependent leakage (exercise)
summary: Teaching exercise for a positive-displacement air compressor whose inlet pressure drop and internal leakage are equivalent nozzles. Throat areas and swept volume come from the first part of the exercise. Efficiency and the leakage ratio are results and vary with speed. The stored point is 6000 rpm.
